name: LpdFi
rootCause: Oracle vulnerability: LpdFi's price() function relied directly on PancakeSwap LPD/USDC pair spot reserves without TWAP protection. Attacker flash-borrowed USDC, manipulated reserves via donate+sync, inflated interest calculations, then claimed interest via removeLp() to drain the protocol's ~1.68M LP position. ~693.5K USDC extracted in single transaction. Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0x70bbe0aa3c7ef149ecb6128a06025885deaa8fef3f393a505d447d28ab3315d6 Source: https://twitter.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2084157533204197380
